subject: Oakwood Health: PHI retention policy & proposed BAA addendum
messages:
From: James Simmons <j.simmons@oakwoodhealth.org>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@oakwoodhealth.org>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: PHI retention windows & supporting evidence request

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week — Oakwood's procurement team is moving quickly. Two items we need to close from a compliance perspective before our security review will sign off:

1) A concise statement of how long Redwood retains cached PHI at rest and in-memory KV caches for inference sessions (we need both default and customer-configurable values).
2) A list of evidence artifacts you can provide for a SOC2 + HIPAA assessment (logs, audit trail retention, dataflow diagram).

I've attached a short questionnaire from our security reviewer (Oakwood_PHI_Data_Retention_Questions.pdf). Can you respond by EOD Thursday? Also please advise if you're open to a one-page BAA addendum that narrows retention & deletion commitments (our legal prefers addenda for specific product modules).

Appreciate it —
James Simmons
Director of IT Security, Oakwood Health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: James Simmons <j.simmons@oakwoodhealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: PHI retention windows & supporting evidence request

James —

Thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire. Quick answers up-front:
- Default PHI retention: ephemeral KV cache kept for inference session lifetime (default TTL 6 hours), persistent logs and audit events retained for 90 days by default.
- Customer-configurable: customers can set KV cache TTL to as low as 0 (no caching) and extend audit/event retention via Dedicated/Private plans up to 7 years under contract.

We're happy to provide the artifacts you requested. Looping in Marissa (Customer Success lead for healthcare) and Marcus (Security/infra) who will put together a package including:
- Dataflow diagram and architecture notes (PHI_dataflow)
- Audit log sample and schema (redacted)
- SOC 2 scope summary and point of contact

On the BAA addendum: we can review a one-page addendum and provide a redline quickly. If Oakwood can share your preferred language, Marcus and I will respond with suggested edits.

I will send an initial package by Wednesday COB. If you'd prefer a call to walk through the retention controls, Marissa can meet Thursday.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: James Simmons <j.simmons@oakwoodhealth.org>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:22:00 -04:00
Subject: PHI artifacts & proposed BAA workflow

James —

Following Rachel's note, attaching the materials we discussed (see attachments). Highlights:
- PHI Dataflow (PHI_Dataflow_Diagram.png) shows isolation points: inference runtime KV cache is ephemeral and only persisted to local GPU memory; no PHI written to long-term object storage unless customer enables logging.
- Audit logs: we include token-level events (request id, timestamp, model id) and can provide redacted samples for review. Default retention 90 days; retention extensions available under Dedicated/Private contracts.

BAA workflow suggestion:
1) Oakwood shares one-page addendum with the specific retention clauses you want to narrow.
2) We provide a redline within 48 business hours.
3) Legal sync for any non-standard escrow/KMS language.

If helpful, Neha can provide the specific contract language we typically accept for PHI deletion windows and KMS key ownership.

Available for a 30-minute call Thursday 11:00 AM ET or Friday 2:00 PM ET.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Healthcare Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@oakwoodhealth.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: James Simmons <j.simmons@oakwoodhealth.org>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 15:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Oakwood BAA addendum draft and two clarifying Qs

Marissa / Rachel —

Attached is the one-page addendum Oakwood's counsel drafted (we kept it narrow): key asks are a 30-day upper bound on transitory PHI in any cache/ephemeral store and confirmation that persistent logs containing PHI will be deleted within 180 days unless otherwise directed. Two quick clarifying questions before we accept your redline:

1) When you say "no PHI written to long-term object storage unless customer enables logging" — can you confirm the opt-in mechanism (console flag vs API) and whether logs are encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys?
2) For Dedicated deployments, is it possible to scope log retention per-tenant (Oakwood would like 180 days default at deploy time).

Attached: Oakwood_BAA_Addendum_Draft.pdf

Elena Morales
Senior Counsel, Oakwood Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@oakwoodhealth.org>, James Simmons <j.simmons@oakwoodhealth.org>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 16:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Oakwood BAA addendum draft and two clarifying Qs

Elena —

Thanks for the draft and the clear questions. Short answers below; redline attached (Redwood_BAA_Addendum_Redline_v1.pdf).

1) Opt-in mechanism & encryption:
- Opt-in: logging is a clear customer-configurable setting exposed via the Console (under Project Settings -> Logging) and via the Admin API (POST /projects/:id/logging). We will include UI and API steps in the evidence package.
- Encryption: all logs at rest are encrypted using AES-256. For Private/Dedicated customers we support customer-managed keys via KMS (bring-your-own-key). We will note this in the redline and include KMS configuration docs.

2) Per-tenant retention in Dedicated:
- Yes. For Dedicated deployments we expose retention as a per-tenant configuration at deploy time and via the Admin API. Default templates can be set to 180 days for Oakwood; we will include the API call examples in the package.

Next steps:
- We attached a redline to your draft for your counsel's review.
- Marissa / Neha happy to do a 30-minute legal + security call if your team wants to walk through wording.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Staff Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
